title: Violin talk and where the Ory photograph came from
summary: Joseph on playing violin; the men study the photo's setting and Joseph says he got it from John Porter about five years earlier.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Fiddlers and reading violinists of New Orleans
